items.item_text: Experience providing customer service in a healthcare, hospitality, custodial, retail or service-oriented environment.
Prior environmental services, custodial, housekeeping, or janitorial experience.

The Senior Custodian (Per Diem) performs a comprehensive range of Environmental Services duties to maintain a clean, safe, sanitary, and welcoming environment throughout UC Davis Health. Under general supervision, the position provides custodial services in both patient care and non-patient care settings, including patient rooms, nursing stations, examination and treatment areas, waiting rooms, restrooms, offices, corridors, and other assigned locations.

Responsibilities include cleaning and disinfecting occupied patient rooms, discharge rooms, and isolation areas; sanitizing equipment and high-touch surfaces; maintaining floors and carpets; properly handling waste and soiled linens; and replenishing supplies. The Senior Custodian responds to routine and urgent cleaning needs, coordinates access to work areas with clinical staff, and identifies and reports maintenance needs, safety hazards, and equipment concerns.

As an integral member of the Environmental Services team, the Senior Custodian contributes to patient safety, infection prevention, and a positive healthcare experience by adhering to established departmental procedures, isolation precautions, and safety standards. This per diem position requires flexibility, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to changing assignments and operational needs while maintaining high standards of cleanliness and service.
Ability to follow oral and written instructions, policies, procedures, and safety guidelines.
Basic computer skills, including the ability to use email, electronic communication devices, and other department-designated software applications.
Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
Ability to operate floor care and cleaning equipment, including vacuums, extractors, and related tools.
Ability to follow departmental procedures and complete assignments within established timeframes.
Ability to recognize and report safety hazards, maintenance concerns, and emergency situations.
Knowledge of basic cleaning methods, materials, equipment, and supplies.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment with changing priorities.
Skills to perform routine cleaning, disinfection, waste handling, and linen collection duties.
Ability to adhere to infection prevention, isolation, and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements.
Ability to communicate effectively and maintain positive working relationships with patients, visitors, and staff.
